purpose: Bridge fixed-spectrum counterfactual sensitivity to attention rows produced during ordinary model execution
input_intervention: Hold keys, values, query, answer, source pair slot, and token multiset fixed; permute only distractor-pair order before an untouched forward pass
matching_rule: Within each base example, retain variant pairs with absolute selected-head source-mass gap at least 0.01, then choose the pair with minimum mean per-head L1 distance between sorted attention rows; orient higher source mass minus lower source mass
primary_outcome: target margin difference in the matched naturally produced pair
secondary_model: Within-base fixed-effects regression of margin on source mass, maximum weight, and entropy
inference_unit: calibration seed above independent base prompt
success_rule: positive hierarchical 95% interval for matched-pair margin and positive source-mass coefficient, with all six seedwise matched-pair means positive
scope: This experiment establishes endogenous traversal and behavioral relevance of the assignment coordinate. It does not give the isolation guarantee of the fixed-spectrum swap.
